findings.note: The generated cross-shard prompt states a result contract the ingestion path rejects. crossShardPack (internal/shardpack/shardpack.go:520) reuses the shared resultContract constant verbatim, so cross-shard.md tells the reviewing agent to write `<resultsDir>/shard-<id>.<shardHash>.result.json` with kind "shard" and a shardId. reviewmanifest requires the opposite for a cross-shard result: kind "cross-shard" (resultBlockers emits "cross-shard result unknown kind shard"), an empty shardId ("cross-shard result must not name a shard"), and the file name cross-shard.<planHash>.result.json (resultNamePattern / ShardIDFromResultPath). An agent following the pack literally therefore produces a result that either is not discovered at all or turns into manifest blockers, and the gate can only be cleared by ignoring the pack — which is what happened on this very review. The 0.8.3 spec (docs/specs/2026-08-27-metareview-0.8.3-sharded-review-results.md:167,179,206) and tests/go/test-sharded-review.sh:77-79 both state the correct form, and skills/commands claim "Each pack states the exact contract", so only the generated cross-shard pack is wrong. Neither the shardpack shard (shard-03-2) nor the reviewmanifest shard (shard-16-3) could see the contradiction alone. Fix: parameterise resultContract for the cross-shard pack (kind, file name, no shardId).
